thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SEV2 triggered — Elevated 5xx rate from gw-prod (us-east-1). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Estimated customer impact: degraded latency and increased errors for ~18% of requests.
jamie_oncall: Picking this up — assigning to oncall. Paging @marta_sre and @tom_runtime.
marta_sre: I see a spike in gateway 502/504 starting ~00:07 UTC. Correlation header sample: `X-Corr-Id: cr-0a1b2c9d`.
tom_runtime: Noting recent runtime deploy at 23:45 UTC — but initial spike starts after 00:07. Pulling logs now.
rachel_cs: We have ~6 customers reporting higher error rates and a couple of 4xx->5xx conversions in their dashboards. Notified tier1.
neil_support: Capturing support traces, sending sample request ids to thread in a sec.
anna_eng: FYI, no infra changes scheduled in region.
infra-bot: Autoscaling events: no recent scale-downs in gw-prod between 23:30-00:15 UTC.
marta_sre: Sharing quick log excerpt (filtered by corr id prefix).
```
[2026-03-17T00:07:12Z] gw-prod proxy: incoming req id=cr-0a1b2c9d route=/v1/generate client=svc-abc upstream=runtime-23 status=502 latency=1250ms err="upstream timeout"
[2026-03-17T00:07:14Z] gw-prod proxy: retry dispatched to upstream runtime-23 req_id=cr-0a1b2c9d retry=1
[2026-03-17T00:07:17Z] runtime-23: kvcache miss req_id=cr-0a1b2c9d load_model=redwood-v1 start=00:07:12
[2026-03-17T00:07:19Z] runtime-23: exec error req_id=cr-0a1b2c9d err="OOM during forward pass"
```
marta_sre: Hypothesis 1 — upstream runtime instances hitting memory pressure causing timeouts -> gateway 502s.
tom_runtime: Confirming runtime-23 logs show frequent OOM kills around the same window. Dumping pod events.
```
kubectl -n runtime get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=runtime-23 | tail -n 10
2026-03-17T00:06:59Z OOMKilled container=engine
2026-03-17T00:07:05Z BackOff restarting container=engine
```

marta_sre: Hypothesis 2 — retry amplification: gateway configured with aggressive retry (2 retries, short backoff) is amplifying load to already strained upstreams -> cascading failures.
jamie_oncall: Immediate mitigations — (1) Reduce gateway retries to 0 for heavy endpoints; (2) Increase runtime pod replicas in us-east-1 by +3; (3) Temporarily route lower-tier traffic to fallback model variant (smaller quantized).
neil_support: Executed #1: updated gateway retry config on gw-prod to retries=0 for /v1/generate and /v1/chat. Changes propagated at 00:09:05 UTC.
infra-bot: Config change applied: gateway retry policy updated (config-id: cfg-9876).
anna_eng: Executed #2: scaled runtime deployment runtime-cluster-us-east replicas from 6 -> 9 at 00:09:18 UTC. New pods coming up.
tom_runtime: Watching pod startup logs. New pods show healthy init, pulling model might increase load — consider staggered start.
rachel_cs: Noting customer-facing mitigations — we informed affected customers about mitigation steps and expected recovery window ~10-15m.
marta_sre: Post-mitigation observation: 5xx rate decreased from 18% -> 4% over next 6 minutes. Latency tail still high for some requests.
jamie_oncall: Good. Now collecting artifact bundle for RCA: - list of affected corr ids (sampled) - gateway logs (00:05-00:15 UTC) - runtime pod events and container logs - deploy history and config changes.
tom_runtime: Attaching sample corr ids: [cr-0a1b2c9d, cr-1b2c3d4e, cr-2c3d4e5f] and link to logbox: https://logbox.internal/redwood/tracebox/3712345678 (shared).

marta_sre: Quick note: patterns show `OOMKilled` in runtime for requests with long context lengths (>2k tokens). Hypothesis 3 — sudden increase in long-context requests (customer or test traffic) causing memory spikes and OOMs. Need request size histograms.
anna_eng: Pulling request size metrics from prometheus: spike in median context token length from 480 -> 1870 between 00:05-00:08 UTC.

marta_sre: So likely root cause = combination of (A) larger-than-usual long-context requests, (B) aggressive gateway retries amplifying load, (C) insufficient headroom on runtime pods due to memory settings.
jamie_oncall: Action items (assigned):
- marta_sre: prepare RCA draft with timeline + log excerpts (due EOD).
- tom_runtime: follow up on runtime memory tuning and add pod-level headroom + podAntiAffinity to avoid co-locating heavy pods (due 48h).
- anna_eng: add request-size alert threshold to avoid silent long-context spikes (P1->P0) (due 24h).
- neil_support & rachel_cs: customer impact summary + outreach notes (due 2h).

marta_sre: Uploading artifact bundle to incident folder: /incidents/3712345678/artifacts (logbox link + pod dumps).
jamie_oncall: Closing live mitigation — oncall standing down, will continue RCA in this thread. If 5xx resurges, re-pager. :white_check_mark:

rachel_cs: Filed customer communication template in thread and pinged affected accounts.

incident-bot: Incident status updated to: mitigated (reach reduced) at 00:14:05 UTC. Next: RCA engineering owner marta_sre.

marta_sre: Starting RCA doc now, will include timeline, root cause reasoning, and preventative mitigations (retry policy change, memory headroom, request-size monitoring). Will link PR for config and infra changes.

jamie_oncall: Thanks team — nice coordination. Handoff to RCA.
